slides.title: Signal red. Road khali. Ruko ya niklo?
slides.body: Raat ke 3 baje, Bunty ka dimaag bola: kaun dekh raha hai?

slides.title: 3:00 AM. Party se wapas.
slides.body:
Signal pe 90 second baaki. Road bilkul khali. Na police, na traffic.
Bunty: "Itni raat ko kaun rukta hai yaar?"

slides.title: Side road se green pe aata rider.
slides.body: Zor ka brake. Sirf 2 feet ka fark tha.

slides.title: "Khali road hi sabse risky hai."
slides.body: Pinky: "Wahan sab tez chalte hain, kyunki sab sochte hain koi nahi aayega."

slides.title: Red light jump = ₹1,000 se ₹5,000 fine
slides.body: Aur kabhi kabhi jail bhi. Par asli khatra fine nahi: khali road pe takkar hamesha full speed pe hoti hai.
slides.small: Source: Motor Vehicles Act 1988, Sec 184 (as amended 2019)

slides.title: Aizawl ko dekho.
slides.body: Mizoram ki capital mein log bina horn bajaye, line mein ruk kar chalte hain. Wahan ye normal hai. Hum bhi kar sakte hain.

slides.title: Red matlab red.
slides.body:
3 baje raat ko bhi.
Signal camera ke liye nahi,
side road wale insaan ke liye maano.

slides.title: Agli raat. Wahi signal.
slides.body: Bunty ruka. Poore 90 second. Koi nahi dekh raha tha. Phir bhi.

lines: Us dost ko bhejo jo khali road pe signal todta hai.
